subject: A public CT dataset sets a benchmark for image-quality scoring
script: From Agewell Brief: A public CT dataset sets a benchmark for image-quality scoring. A new annotated dataset of 1,764 cone-beam CT slices enables reproducible research on quantitative image quality assessment, balancing diagnostic accuracy with radiation dose. 1,764 annotated CBCT slices with expert scores for overall and ROI quality. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
